title: The Cordyceps Fungus
description: The World Has Changed - The Cordyceps fungus is spreading and consuming the world. Defend - Fight  - Adapt!
body:
![The cordyceps fungus banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/477e7b00759d41f341cb5e0cefd2d9768eff8e49.webp) **
Conquer The Cordyceps Fungus | Ultimate Apocalypse Experience
** ### No Turning Back The infection has irreversibly claimed the world. Its spread is unstoppable, constantly evolving and adapting to every environment. You are forced to coexist with it, powerless to halt its advance. ![infected world picture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7647737d0427cdaf8bba83e01efdd1009998cacd_0.webp) ### Defense Is Crucial With no means of stopping the infection, your only hope for survival lies in defense. Start with simple spikes, upgrade to barbed wire, and eventually deploy powerful cannons to fortify your position. ![defending castle picture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78a1ba009cd2a7d4fb6b6221aacac02a34e01e40.webp) ### Investigate Infected Structures These ominous structures may hold secrets about the infection's origin. Explore them at your peril, but be warned: infected entities may still lurk within. ![infected structure picture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49072b8f7ec49625f44f64324e8f97cdc9853a4c.webp) ### Adapt and Conquer The infected are vulnerable to cold, making colder regions a strategic advantage. Craft powerful bio-weapons from their remains. ![frozen environment picture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c393491c30163bd8e4d48465908b87f603aea32_0.webp) ### 👀 Play with friends Want to run a flawless modded server?
